notes.text: Available in cPanel 76 and later. Returns the protocols whose bandwidth the server records; http includes web traffic on ports 80 and 443. This read does not change protocol configuration.

Available in cPanel 11.52 and later. Each optional interval and retention field is preserved without filling omitted values. The pinned retention schema is an integer with unix_timestamp format; no additional duration conversion or inferred unit is applied.

Available in cPanel 11.52 and later; queries the selected account and includes distributed-account bandwidth usage. Omitted domains selects all account domains. UNKNOWN identifies traffic without a specific domain; all non-HTTP traffic is recorded that way.

grouping, domains and protocols are pre-serialized pipe-separated strings, following the pinned pipeDelimited, explode=false declarations and examples. The client sends each supplied string once without splitting, reordering or adding a parameter-name prefix. grouping is required; optional report bounds, interval, domains, protocols and timezone remain omitted unless supplied. The documented interval default is daily and available data depends on retention.

The source says grouping must contain domain or protocol, permits at most three values and one time interval, yet also shows a time-only example. Its prose misspells year_month_day_hour_minute as year_month_day_mour_minute while the schema uses the former. These source inconsistencies remain explicit; the client does not validate grouping combinations or infer extra parameter values.

The pinned response examples and grouping prose establish one, two or three dynamic key levels in the declared grouping order, ending in numeric bandwidth bytes. Integer and finite fractional leaves are preserved, including the documented 11036.0461226852 value; numeric strings are not inferred. The formal schema mislabels byte leaves as objects. Its nullable second- and third-group values remain nullable, and empty grouping maps remain empty. The bounded result shape does not enforce correspondence between a supplied grouping string and a particular response depth.

The original 2026-10-31-resource-statistics.json capture at fb4f9c9eb03e094d89a41806e927c4cbf0c60432 on cPanel 11.138.0.19 observed integer byte leaves at $.*.* for grouping=domain|protocol through both routes. Review 5719939412 also reports successful API responses rejected at one and three grouping levels. The pinned examples establish those shapes and fractional byte leaves independently; the original immutable artifact remains unchanged.

evidence.note: Pinned cpanel.openapi.json.gz SHA-256 172660ce0d8e0868756dabf8e3243ea41399aac7bff06082d806c73f71a094fc, /Bandwidth/query GET response application/json examples domain, domain_year, year_domain and domain_protocol_year, gives numeric byte leaves at one, two and three grouping levels. The three-level example includes 11036.0461226852 and 2525944.05255787. Parameter prose permits at most three values and response prose ties the hierarchy to their order. Correct the formal schema object-only leaves to bounded maps ending in number, preserving its second/third nullable values. Reject unestablished numeric strings and fourth-level or opaque leaves; retain empty-map compatibility. This is a pinned-documentation correction, not fractional live evidence.

Original immutable docs/api/evidence/2026-10-31-resource-statistics.json (SHA-256 6114814a2c39e52080d34c90cf0790380c16b86d3dca87677cb00fea50a407f3), captured at revision fb4f9c9eb03e094d89a41806e927c4cbf0c60432 on cPanel 11.138.0.19 from pinned source SHA-256 172660ce0d8e0868756dabf8e3243ea41399aac7bff06082d806c73f71a094fc, records HTTP 200 and API success on direct-uapi and bridged-uapi GET routes. For the fixed catalog grouping=domain|protocol, payload paths $ and $.* are objects and $.*.* is int, with type_mismatch at $.*.* under effective contract 199c3cd48f4dd5e801bc785c94a7d192bf6c54a8c06556def0211cb23892f1fc. This artifact establishes two-level integer leaves only. The separate pinned examples establish the other depths and fractional leaves; preserve the original failed artifact unchanged.
